notes:
- Improved champion tooltip accuracy across many abilities and passives.
- Fixed several cases where tooltip values were missing, shown as 0, or mapped to the wrong scaling.
- Corrected multiple level-based and max-health-based tooltip values so they now display proper progression.
- Fixed passive tooltip mismatches where some champions showed another slot's text.
- Improved tooltip fallback handling to reduce unresolved or partially rendered values.
- Better patch-to-patch reliability for tooltip data updates across locales.
